type.quote: The West Virginia Board of Optometry is continued.

age_minimum.quote: Be at least twenty-one years of age

interval_years.quote: A licensee shall annually or biennially on or before July 1, renew his or her license

required.quote: The board shall require as a condition of renewal of a license that each licensee complete continuing education.

available.quote: The board may enter into agreements for reciprocal licensing with other jurisdictions having substantially similar requirements for licensure.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid license from another jurisdiction with substantially equivalent requirements, have no pending charges or prior revocations, not have previously failed the WV examination, pay the applicable fee, pass the board-prescribed examination, and fulfill any other board requirements.
requirements.quote: Holds a license or other authorization to practice optometry in another state which requirements are substantially equivalent to those required in this state

title_protection.quote: A person who is not licensed under this article as an optometrist may not characterize himself or herself as an "optometrist" or "doctor of optometry" nor may a person use the designation "OD".

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice or offer to practice optometry in this state without a license or permit issued under the provisions of this article

disciplinary_grounds.description: False and deceptive advertising, including advertising free eye examinations or inaccurately describing optical devices
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False and deceptive advertising; this includes, but is not limited to, the following: (A) Advertising "free examination of eyes", or words of similar import and meaning

definition_quote.value: The examining, diagnosing, and treating of any visual defect or abnormal condition of the human eye or its appendages within the scope established in this article or associated rules and the performance of those procedures taught and trained through schools or colleges of optometry accredited by the Accreditation Council on Optometric Education, or its successors or equivalents
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of optometry" means the examining, diagnosing, and treating of any visual defect or abnormal condition of the human eye or its appendages within the scope established in this article or associated rules and the performance of those procedures taught and trained through schools or colleges of optometry accredited by the Accreditation Council on Optometric Education, or its successors or equivalents

value: treatment of diseases and conditions of the human eye and its appendages
prescribing and administering topical pharmaceutical agents
prescribing oral pharmaceutical agents from the drug formulary
administering epinephrine by injection for anaphylaxis
prescribing and dispensing pharmaceutical contact lenses
prescribing, fitting, applying lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, vision rehabilitation
use of diagnostic or therapeutic laser
methods_authorized.quote: A licensee may: (1) Examine, diagnose, and treat diseases and conditions of the human eye and its appendages within the scope established in this article or associated rules

drug_authority.value: Licensees with a certificate may administer or prescribe topical pharmaceutical agents and oral pharmaceutical agents from the board-established drug formulary (Schedules III, IV, V, plus oral antibiotics, NSAIDs, and carbonic anhydrase inhibitors); may also administer epinephrine by injection for anaphylaxis
drug_authority.quote: Administer or prescribe any drug for topical application to the anterior segment of the human eye for use in the examination, diagnosis, or treatment of diseases and conditions of the human eye and its appendages: Provided, That the licensee has first obtained a certificate

surgery_prohibited.quote: A licensee may not: (1) Perform surgery except as provided in this article; or by legislative rule

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: Remove a foreign body from the ocular surface and adnexa utilizing a nonintrusive method

value: laser procedures as outlined in section 30-8B-1 et seq.
laser_procedures_authorized.quote: Use a diagnostic or therapeutic laser; and ... A licensee may perform laser procedures as outlined in section 30-8B-1 et seq. of this code.

value: Dilation of the lacrimal puncta with or without irrigation
Remove embedded foreign bodies or concretions from conjunctiva using topical anesthesia not involving sclera
Remove corneal foreign body not through to the second layer of the cornea using topical anesthesia
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Epilation of lashes by forceps; (F) Closure of punctum by plug; and (G) Dilation of the lacrimal puncta with or without irrigation

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: Administer epinephrine by injection to treat emergency cases of anaphylaxis or anaphylactic shock

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Prescribe, fit, apply, replace, duplicate, or alter lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, vision rehabilitation

value: Schedule II controlled substances prohibited (except hydrocodone/hydrocodone-containing drugs up to 3 days for oral pharmaceutical certified licensees)
Schedules III, IV, and V permitted via drug formulary with certificate
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: Use Schedule II controlled substances. However, an oral pharmaceutical certified licensee may prescribe hydrocodone and hydrocodone containing drugs for a duration of no more than three days

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: an oral pharmaceutical certified licensee may prescribe hydrocodone and hydrocodone containing drugs for a duration of no more than three days

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: oral pharmaceutical agents that are included in the drug formulary established by the board pursuant to section six of this article

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Administer or prescribe any drug for topical application to the anterior segment of the human eye for use in the examination, diagnosis, or treatment of diseases and conditions of the human eye and its appendages: Provided, That the licensee has first obtained a certificate

tiered_license_types.quote: "Certificate" means a prescription certificate issued under 30-8-15 of this code; "Certificate holder" means a person authorized to prescribe certain drugs under 30-8-15 of this code

value: prescription certificate (for topical and oral pharmaceutical agents)
specialty_certification_types.quote: "Certificate" means a prescription certificate issued under 30-8-15 of this code

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: a licensee may not delegate the authority to administer pharmaceutical agents by injection to any other person

retired_license_status_available.quote: There is established a special volunteer license for optometrists who are retired or are retiring from the active practice of optometry
